record.paper_title: Space and Time Complexity of Exact Algorithms: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For Table-6-SUM, where the input is a 6 by m table of integers together with a goal sum S and the task is to choose exactly one entry from each row so that the six chosen entries sum to S, is there an algorithm running in O(m^3 log m) time while using only O(m) space?

evidence.quote: Is there an O(m3 log m) time and O(m) space algorithm for Table-6-SUM?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Define the Table-6-SUM problem as follows. The input consists of a 6 × m matrix A of integers (six rows, m columns) and a target integer S. The task is to decide whether one can select exactly one entry from each of the six rows so that the six chosen entries sum to S; equivalently, decide whether there exist column indices j_1, j_2, j_3, j_4, j_5, j_6 ∈ {1, …, m} (not required to be distinct) such that A[1, j_1] + A[2, j_2] + A[3, j_3] + A[4, j_4] + A[5, j_5] + A[6, j_6] = S. Assume the standard word-RAM model in which arithmetic on integers of size polynomial in the input fits in O(1) words and space is counted in words.

Question: Does there exist a deterministic algorithm that solves Table-6-SUM in O(m^3 log m) time while using only O(m) words of working space?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a published resolution of this specific Table-6-SUM time–space tradeoff question (O(m^3 log m) time with O(m) space). Related work on space-efficient k-SUM algorithms (e.g., Bansal–Garg–Korten–Nederlof–Vyas and subsequent low-space subset-sum/k-SUM results) gives space-efficient algorithms for k-SUM variants, and randomized algorithms achieving O(n^{k-0.5} polylog n) time with O(log n) space for random k-SUM instances are known, but none of these appear to settle the deterministic worst-case Table-6-SUM bound asked for. Status appears unresolved based on available sources.

status_evidence.title: Faster Space-Efficient Algorithms for Subset Sum, k-Sum and Related Problems
status_evidence.snippet: random instances of k-Sum can be solved using O(n^{k-0.5} polylog(n)) time and O(log n) space
status_evidence.claim: Provides space-efficient k-SUM algorithms but does not specifically resolve the Table-6-SUM O(m^3 log m) time, O(m) space question.

status_evidence.title: Space and Time Complexity of Exact Algorithms: Some Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems regarding worst-case time and space bounds for exact algorithms.
status_evidence.claim: The Table-6-SUM question is posed as an open problem on space–time tradeoffs.

status_evidence.title: Fast Low-Space Algorithms for Subset Sum
status_evidence.snippet: Low-space algorithms for subset sum and related k-SUM problems.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent low-space results for related problems do not appear to give an O(m^3 log m)-time, O(m)-space deterministic algorithm for Table-6-SUM.
